_comment: Dimension two: environment. Only describes 'which environment to hit', never contains VU counts/durations (that is the job of profiles/)

services._comment: The 5 services are addressed independently. Deliberately no global host -- a request that forgets to specify its service fails outright instead of silently hitting another service.
services._placeholder: The four groups below are still placeholders (NFR pending confirmation #12). Deliberately not filled in alongside workers -- a correct guess would go unverified, and a wrong guess shows up as 404, which reads as 'endpoint does not exist' rather than 'address misconfigured'. localhost gives connection refused, instantly recognizable as unconfigured. p02 is unaffected.

identity._comment: This project has no login / no token; authorization is entirely determined by X-User-Id. Roles are fixed, never rotated: the four-eyes principle requires checker != maker (NFR SEC-02).

_preflight: abort | warn (prune not implemented). dev data fluctuates a lot; default is warn.
_dynRun: From a real curl; semantics pending confirmation
